newsitem.title: MEXICO: Liverpool $40 mln expansion plan - source.
newsitem.headline: Liverpool $40 mln expansion plan - source.

text.p: Mexican retailer El Puerto de Liverpool S.A. de C.V. has earmarked $40 million for expansion plans in 1997, a company official told Reuters on Thursday.
"We have $40 million in mind for our expansion plans...we aim to have 20 stores by the end of 1997," a Liverpool director, who declined to be named because of company policy, told Reuters.
The source said Liverpool could open another store in the city of Puebla, 100 kilometers east of Mexico City.
The retail chain currently has 11 stores trading under the Liverpool name and an additional eight as "Fabricas de Francia" across Mexico.

Liverpool had yet to decide what to do with the $74.25 million garnered from its sale of a 50-percent stake in Kmart Mexico, the source said, adding the company now had approximately $115 million in treasury.
Analysts have suggested Liverpool may use the funds toward paying off debts estimated at some $100 million.
